tagline: Enabling chipmakers to create smaller, faster and more energy-efficient chips
hero_kpi_rationale: The backlog is the primary leading indicator of future revenue at ASML, directly reflecting demand for lithography equipment in advanced nodes (EUV, High-NA), which drive semiconductor miniaturization and the rise of AI.

kpis.name: Net Bookings
kpis.explanation: Total value of new equipment orders signed during the year.
kpis.description: Net bookings increased in 2025, supported by the transition to advanced lithography nodes among leading foundries.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in bookings, driven by demand for EUV and High-NA.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of sales, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high due to ASML's monopolistic position in EUV lithography and cost optimization.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical of leading semiconductor technology companies.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: The strong margin reflects ASML's market power and disciplined expense management.
kpis.signal: Operating margin among the highest in the tech sector.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: ASML maintains a high level of R&D investment to develop High-NA systems and improve the efficiency of existing tools. The source indicates a target of 10-15% of revenue, confirming this trajectory.
kpis.signal: High level of continuous innovation, critical to maintaining technological leadership.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain and expand production capacity.
kpis.description: Capex is increasing to strengthen supply chains and accelerate EUV tool production.
kpis.signal: Capex growth to meet rising equipment demand.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.description: ASML is hiring aggressively, particularly in engineering and customer support, to manage the increasing complexity of its systems.
kpis.signal: Sustained headcount growth to support technological expansion.

kpis.name: Net System Sales
kpis.explanation: FY25 Net System Sales = EUR 24.474 Bn (+12.4% YoY). Across 535 litho units. Premium EUV mix drives value
kpis.description: FY25 Net System Sales = EUR 24.474 Bn (+12.4% YoY). Across 535 litho units. Premium EUV mix drives unit value. Core KPI in semiconductor equipment.

kpis.name: EUV System Sales (NXE+EXE)
kpis.explanation: FY25 EUV total revenue = NXE EUR 10.446 Bn (44 units) + EXE 0.55NA EUR 1.157 Bn (4 units). +39% YoY
kpis.description: FY25 EUV total revenue = NXE EUR 10.446 Bn (44 units) + EXE 0.55NA EUR 1.157 Bn (4 units). +39% YoY. Structural AI demand. CORE thesis.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: End-2025 backlog = EUR 38.8 Bn (CEO Fouquet). RPO EUR 46.5 Bn, of which 65% to be recognized over 12 months. Key visibility KPI
kpis.description: End-2025 backlog = EUR 38.8 Bn (CEO Fouquet). RPO EUR 46.5 Bn, of which 65% to be recognized over 12 months. Key visibility KPI - replaces historical 'Bookings'.

kpis.name: Total Net Sales
kpis.explanation: FY25 Total = EUR 32.667 Bn (+15.6%). Split: Logic EUR 16.054 Bn (49%) / Memory EUR 8.420 Bn (26%)
kpis.description: FY25 Total = EUR 32.667 Bn (+15.6%). Split: Logic EUR 16.054 Bn (49%) / Memory EUR 8.420 Bn (26%) / Service & Field Options EUR 8.193 Bn (25%). S&FO +26.2% YoY.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: FY25 NI = EUR 9.609 Bn (+26.9% YoY). EPS basic EUR 24.73 (FY24: EUR 19.25, +28.5%).
kpis.description: FY25 NI = EUR 9.609 Bn (+26.9% YoY). EPS basic EUR 24.73 (FY24: EUR 19.25, +28.5%).

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: FY25 FCF = EUR 11.0 Bn (+20.9%). OCF EUR 12.658 Bn - capex EUR 1.632 Bn. Return to shareholders EUR
kpis.description: FY25 FCF = EUR 11.0 Bn (+20.9%). OCF EUR 12.658 Bn - capex EUR 1.632 Bn. Return to shareholders EUR 8.5 Bn (div + buybacks).

kpis.name: EUV Units Recognized
kpis.explanation: FY25 = 48 EUV units (44 NXE + 4 EXE 0.55NA) vs 44 FY24. EXE 5200B at full spec delivered to first customer
kpis.description: FY25 = 48 EUV units (44 NXE + 4 EXE 0.55NA) vs 44 FY24. EXE 5200B at full spec delivered to first customer in FY25. Volume hardware for leading-edge nodes.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $5.534 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $2.55 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 26.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Bookings
kpis.explanation: Total value of new equipment orders signed during the year.
kpis.description: Bookings have increased every year since 2021, driven by EUV adoption and the imminent deployment of High-NA.
kpis.signal: Acceleration in demand for advanced lithography tools.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: The R&D/revenue ratio has been steadily increasing, reflecting the need to invest to stay ahead in the technology race.

risks.title: Dependence on customer demand for advanced semiconductors
risks.score_rationale: Major risk mentioned implicitly in strategy (focus on EUV/DUV for advanced customers). Moderate language but context of high geopolitical uncertainty. Stable trend but structural dependence on customer investment cycles. High weight for business model.

risks.title: Export restrictions and geopolitical controls (China)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements ('export control policy and regulations and expected impact on us'). Urgent language ('with urgency'). Trend increasing (2025 US-China tensions context). Critical weight for access to major market and revenues.

risks.title: Technological complexity and R&D risks in EUV/High-NA
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in description of technical challenges ('almost 10 years of tremendous work', 'maturity' mentioned 3x). Complex technical language indicating major engineering challenges. Stable trend but intensive R&D efforts (€4.7bn). High weight for product differentiation.

risks.title: Complex supply chain and dependence on critical suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Implied in 'ecosystem overview' and '5,100 Total number of suppliers'. Moderate language but high geopolitical context. Trend increasing (supply chain tensions post-2022). High weight for production and delivery timelines.

risks.title: Intellectual property and risks of counterfeiting/technology theft
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly detailed in the excerpt but implicit in 'technology roadmap' and geopolitical context. Indirect language but high US-China tensions. Trend increasing (rising IP theft). High weight for competitive advantage.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and protection of customer/proprietary data
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in table of contents ('Information security | 2') but details absent from excerpt. Moderate language. Trend increasing (growing cyber threats). High weight for critical operations and sensitive data.

risks.title: Technological competition and pressure on gross margins
risks.score_rationale: Implied in 'cost of technology benefits' and focus on productivity (160→230 wph). Moderate language but context of intense innovation. Stable trend but growing pressure. High weight for profitability (52.8% margin).

risks.title: Energy consumption of EUV systems and sustainability
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned ('energy consumption of an EUV machine is a long-term challenge', '57% reduction since 2018', 'target further 30-40% reduction'). Urgent language ('with urgency'). Trend increasing (AI demand fuels energy concerns). Moderate weight for reputation/regulation.

ai_positioning.summary: ASML integrates AI into its design, predictive maintenance, and lithography system optimization processes, but does not position AI as a core product. Its role is to enable the AI era by providing the manufacturing tools for the chips that power it.
evidence: Mention of AI use in machine performance optimization
Development of intelligent software solutions for predictive maintenance
Collaboration with customers to improve manufacturing processes via advanced algorithms
